void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool has(int[] items, int target)
    for item := items[]
        if item == target
            return true
    return false

bool includes(string[] items, string target)
    for item := items[]
        if item == target
            return true
    return false

string other(string color)
    return if color == "B" then "W" else "B"

string columns()
    return "ABCDEFGHJKLMNOPQRST"

string[] handicap_names(int size)
    if size == 9
        return "C3 G7 C7 G3 C5 G5 E3 E7 E5".split(" ")
    if size == 13
        return "D4 K10 D10 K4 D7 K7 G4 G10 G7".split(" ")
    return "D4 Q16 D16 Q4 D10 Q10 K4 K16 K10".split(" ")

string point_name(int point, int size)
    return columns()[point % size] + "{point / size + 1}"

int point_number(string text, int size)
    if #text < 2
        return -1
    match columns().find(text[0])
        nat column
            if column >= nat(size)
                return -1
            row_text := text[1:]
            if row_text == "" or row_text[0] == "0"
                return -1
            for: i < #row_text
                if not "0123456789".contains(row_text[i])
                    return -1
            match int(row_text)
                int row
                    if not (1 <= row <= size)
                        return -1
                    return size * (row - 1) + int(column)
                error problem
                    return -1
        none
            return -1

string sgf(int point, int size)
    alphabet := "abcdefghijklmnopqrs"
    return alphabet[point % size] + alphabet[size - 1 - point / size]

int[] adjacent(int point, int size, diagonal := false)
    int[] result := []
    int[][] steps := if diagonal then [[-1, -1], [-1, 1], [1, -1], [1, 1]] else [[-1, 0], [1, 0], [0, -1], [0, 1]]
    for delta := steps[]
        r := point / size + delta[0]
        c := point % size + delta[1]
        if 0 <= r < size and 0 <= c < size
            result = result.append(size * r + c)
    return result

int[] flood(string[] board, int size, int point, string allowed)
    seen := array(#board, fill = false)
    queue := [point]
    seen[point] = true
    nat cursor := 0
    while cursor < #queue
        current := queue[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        for neighbor := adjacent(current, size)[]
            if not seen[neighbor] and allowed.contains(board[neighbor])
                seen[neighbor] = true
                queue = queue.append(neighbor)
    return queue.sorted()

int[] unique(int[] items)
    int[] result := []
    for item := items.sorted()[]
        if not has(result, item)
            result = result.append(item)
    return result

class Group(string color, int first, int[] stones, int[] liberties)

Group group(string[] board, int size, int point)
    stones := flood(board, size, point, board[point])
    int[] liberties := []
    for stone := stones[]
        for neighbor := adjacent(stone, size)[]
            if board[neighbor] == "."
                liberties = liberties.append(neighbor)
    return Group(board[point], stones[0], stones, unique(liberties))

Group[] groups(string[] board, int size, color := "")
    seen := array(#board, fill = false)
    Group[] result := []
    for: point < int(#board)
        if board[point] == "." or seen[point] or (color != "" and board[point] != color)
            continue
        current := group(board, size, point)
        result = result.append(current)
        for stone := current.stones[]
            seen[stone] = true
    return result

class Attempt(string[] board, int captured, string reason)

Attempt placement(string[] board, int size, string color, int point)
    if board[point] != "."
        return Attempt(board, 0, "occupied")
    result := board
    result[point] = color
    captured := 0
    seen := array(#board, fill = false)
    for neighbor := adjacent(point, size)[]
        if result[neighbor] == other(color) and not seen[neighbor]
            enemy := group(result, size, neighbor)
            for stone := enemy.stones[]
                seen[stone] = true
            if #enemy.liberties == 0
                for stone := enemy.stones[]
                    result[stone] = "."
                    captured += 1
    reason := if #group(result, size, point).liberties == 0 then "suicide" else ""
    return Attempt(result, captured, reason)

class Region(int first, int[] points, string owner)

Region[] regions(string[] board, int size)
    seen := array(#board, fill = false)
    Region[] result := []
    for: point < int(#board)
        if board[point] != "." or seen[point]
            continue
        points := flood(board, size, point, ".")
        string[] border := []
        for current := points[]
            seen[current] = true
            for neighbor := adjacent(current, size)[]
                if board[neighbor] != "." and not includes(border, board[neighbor])
                    border = border.append(board[neighbor])
        result = result.append(Region(point, points, if #border == 1 then border[0] else "neutral"))
    return result

class Area(int[] touching, int[] vital)

Group[] safe(string[] board, int size, string color)
    own := groups(board, size, color)
    marked := array(#board, fill = false)
    Area[] areas := []
    for: point < int(#board)
        if board[point] == color or marked[point]
            continue
        region := flood(board, size, point, "." + other(color))
        for cell := region[]
            marked[cell] = true
        int[] touching := []
        int[] vital := []
        for: i < #own
            g := own[i]
            touches := false
            all_liberties := true
            for cell := region[]
                if board[cell] == "." and not has(g.liberties, cell)
                    all_liberties = false
                for neighbor := adjacent(cell, size)[]
                    if has(g.stones, neighbor)
                        touches = true
            if touches
                touching = touching.append(int(i))
            if all_liberties
                vital = vital.append(int(i))
        areas = areas.append(Area(touching, vital))
    kept_groups := array(#own, fill = true)
    kept_areas := array(#areas, fill = true)
    while true
        changed := false
        for: i < #own
            if not kept_groups[i]
                continue
            count := 0
            for: j < #areas
                if kept_areas[j] and has(areas[j].vital, int(i))
                    count += 1
            if count < 2
                kept_groups[i] = false
                changed = true
        for: j < #areas
            if not kept_areas[j]
                continue
            for i := areas[j].touching[]
                if not kept_groups[i]
                    kept_areas[j] = false
                    changed = true
                    break
        if not changed
            break
    Group[] result := []
    for: i < #own
        if kept_groups[i]
            result = result.append(own[i])
    return result

class Reading(bool success, int point)

Reading attack(string[] board, int size, int point, int depth);

Reading defend(string[] board, int size, int point, int depth)
    if depth >= 40
        return Reading(true, -1)
    defender := board[point]
    attacker := other(defender)
    g := group(board, size, point)
    choices := g.liberties
    seen := array(#board, fill = false)
    for stone := g.stones[]
        for neighbor := adjacent(stone, size)[]
            if board[neighbor] == attacker and not seen[neighbor]
                enemy := group(board, size, neighbor)
                for member := enemy.stones[]
                    seen[member] = true
                if #enemy.liberties == 1
                    choices = choices.append(enemy.liberties[0])
    for q := unique(choices)[]
        candidate := placement(board, size, defender, q)
        if candidate.reason != ""
            continue
        m := int(#group(candidate.board, size, point).liberties)
        if m >= 3 or (m == 2 and not attack(candidate.board, size, point, depth + 1).success)
            return Reading(true, q)
    return Reading(false, -1)

Reading attack(string[] board, int size, int point, int depth)
    if depth >= 40
        return Reading(false, -1)
    attacker := other(board[point])
    for q := group(board, size, point).liberties[]
        candidate := placement(board, size, attacker, q)
        if candidate.reason == "" and not defend(candidate.board, size, point, depth + 1).success
            return Reading(true, q)
    return Reading(false, -1)

Reading ladder(string[] board, int size, int point)
    liberties := int(#group(board, size, point).liberties)
    if liberties >= 3
        return Reading(true, -1)
    if liberties == 1
        return defend(board, size, point, 0)
    reading := attack(board, size, point, 0)
    return Reading(reading.success, reading.point)

string half(int number)
    absolute := if number < 0 then -number else number
    return (if number < 0 then "-" else "") + "{absolute / 2}." + (if absolute % 2 == 0 then "0" else "5")

int | none parse_komi(string word)
    negative := word.starts_with("-")
    digits := if negative then word[1:] else word
    parts := digits.split(".")
    if #parts < 1 or #parts > 2
        return none
    whole := parts[0]
    if whole == "" or (#whole > 1 and whole[0] == "0")
        return none
    for: i < #whole
        if not "0123456789".contains(whole[i])
            return none
    if #whole > 3
        return none
    amount := int(whole)
    if amount > 100
        return none
    fraction := 0
    if #parts == 2
        if parts[1] != "0" and parts[1] != "5"
            return none
        if parts[1] == "5"
            fraction = 1
    result := 2 * amount + fraction
    if negative and result == 0
        return none
    return if negative then -result else result

int color_index(string color)
    return if color == "B" then 0 else 1

class Position(string[] board, string turn, int[] captures, int passes, bool over)
class Move(string color, int point, int captured, Position before)
class ReplayRecord(string color, int point)

ReplayRecord[] | none parse_record(string sequence, int size)
    ReplayRecord[] records := []
    nat at := 0
    while at < #sequence
        if at + 3 >= #sequence or sequence[at] != ";" or not includes(["B", "W"], sequence[at + 1]) or sequence[at + 2] != "["
            return none
        color := sequence[at + 1]
        at += 3
        point := -1
        if sequence[at] != "]"
            if at + 2 >= #sequence
                return none
            alphabet := "abcdefghijklmnopqrs"
            letter := sequence[at]
            row_letter := sequence[at + 1]
            match alphabet.find(letter)
                nat column
                    match alphabet.find(row_letter)
                        nat row
                            if column >= nat(size) or row >= nat(size)
                                return none
                            point = (size - 1 - int(row)) * size + int(column)
                        none
                            return none
                none
                    return none
            at += 2
        if at >= #sequence or sequence[at] != "]"
            return none
        at += 1
        records = records.append(ReplayRecord(color, point))
    if #records == 0
        return none
    return records

class Game()
    size := 19
    komi := 13
    superko := false
    position := Position(array(361, fill = "."), "B", [0, 0], 0, false)
    int[] handicap := []
    Move[] history := []
    positions := [array(361, fill = ".")]
    dead := array(361, fill = false)

void reset(Game &game, int size, int komi)
    game.size = size
    game.komi = komi
    game.position = Position(array(nat(size * size), fill = "."), "B", [0, 0], 0, false)
    game.handicap = []
    game.history = []
    game.positions = [game.position.board]
    game.dead = array(nat(size * size), fill = false)

Attempt check(Game game, string color, int point)
    result := placement(game.position.board, game.size, color, point)
    flat := result.board.join("")
    if result.reason == "" and #game.positions >= 2 and flat == game.positions[-2].join("")
        result.reason = "ko"
    if result.reason == "" and game.superko
        for old := game.positions[]
            if flat == old.join("")
                result.reason = "superko"
                break
    return result

int move(Game &game, string color, int point, attempt := Attempt([], 0, ""))
    Position before := game.position
    captured := 0
    if point < 0
        game.position.passes += 1
        if game.position.passes == 2
            game.position.over = true
    else
        result := if #attempt.board != 0 then attempt else check(game, color, point)
        game.position.board = result.board
        captured = result.captured
        game.position.captures[color_index(color)] += captured
        game.position.passes = 0
    game.position.turn = other(color)
    game.history = game.history.append(Move(color, point, captured, before))
    game.positions = game.positions.append(game.position.board)
    game.dead = array(nat(game.size * game.size), fill = false)
    return captured

string[] clean(Game game)
    string[] board := game.position.board
    for: p < int(#board)
        if game.dead[p]
            board[p] = "."
    return board

void board_display(Game game, bool show_map)
    string[] board := if show_map then clean(game) else game.position.board
    glyphs := board
    stars := array(nat(game.size * game.size), fill = false)
    names := handicap_names(game.size)
    for: i < #names
        if game.size == 19 or i < 4 or i == 8
            stars[point_number(names[i], game.size)] = true
    if show_map
        for region := regions(board, game.size)[]
            for cell := region.points[]
                glyphs[cell] = if region.owner == "B" then "x" elif region.owner == "W" then "o" else "."
    for: p < int(#board)
        if board[p] == "B"
            glyphs[p] = if not show_map and game.dead[p] then "x" else "X"
        elif board[p] == "W"
            glyphs[p] = if not show_map and game.dead[p] then "o" else "O"
        elif not show_map
            glyphs[p] = if stars[p] then "+" else "."
    header := "   " + [for c := (0:<game.size)[] then columns()[c]].join(" ")
    emit(header)
    for: game.size >= r >= 1 step -1
        string[] row := []
        for: c < game.size
            row = row.append(glyphs[(r - 1) * game.size + c])
        emit((if r < 10 then " " else "") + "{r} " + row.join(" ") + " {r}")
    emit(header)

void score(Game game, string method)
    board := clean(game)
    territory := [0, 0]
    for region := regions(board, game.size)[]
        if region.owner != "neutral"
            territory[color_index(region.owner)] += int(#region.points)
    totals := [0, 0]
    for color := ["B", "W"][]
        index := color_index(color)
        if method == "AREA"
            stones := 0
            for disc := board[]
                if disc == color
                    stones += 1
            totals[index] = 2 * (stones + territory[index]) + (if color == "W" then game.komi else 0)
            emit("{color} stones {stones} territory {territory[index]}" + (if color == "W" then " komi {half(game.komi)}" else "") + " total {half(totals[index])}")
        else
            int prisoners := game.position.captures[index]
            for: p < int(#board)
                if game.dead[p] and game.position.board[p] == other(color)
                    prisoners += 1
            totals[index] = 2 * (territory[index] + prisoners) + (if color == "W" then game.komi else 0)
            emit("{color} territory {territory[index]} prisoners {prisoners}" + (if color == "W" then " komi {half(game.komi)}" else "") + " total {half(totals[index])}")
    difference := totals[0] - totals[1]
    emit(if difference == 0 then "result Draw" elif difference > 0 then "result B+{half(difference)}" else "result W+{half(-difference)}")

bool valid_color(string word)
    return word == "B" or word == "W"

void execute(Game &game, string line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    command := words[0]
    args := words[1:]
    names := "BOARD KOMI SUPERKO HANDICAP PLAY PASS REPLAY UNDO SHOW MAP STATUS CAPTURES HISTORY MOVES GROUP GROUPS ATARI LEGAL EYES SAFE LADDER DEAD REGIONS SCORE".split(" ")
    if not includes(names, command)
        emit("ERROR unknown command")
        return
    needs_two := command == "BOARD" or command == "PLAY"
    needs_one := includes("KOMI SUPERKO HANDICAP PASS REPLAY GROUP LEGAL EYES SAFE LADDER DEAD SCORE".split(" "), command)
    nat expected := if needs_two then 2 elif needs_one then 1 else 0
    if #args != expected
        emit("ERROR bad arguments")
        return
    new_size := game.size
    parsed_komi := game.komi
    valid := true
    if command == "BOARD"
        valid = includes(["9", "13", "19"], args[0])
        if valid
            new_size = int(args[0])
            match parse_komi(args[1])
                int amount
                    parsed_komi = amount
                none
                    valid = false
    elif command == "KOMI"
        match parse_komi(args[0])
            int amount
                parsed_komi = amount
            none
                valid = false
    elif command == "SUPERKO"
        valid = args[0] == "ON" or args[0] == "OFF"
    elif command == "HANDICAP"
        valid = #args[0] == 1 and "23456789".contains(args[0])
    elif includes(["PLAY", "PASS", "LEGAL", "EYES", "SAFE"], command)
        valid = valid_color(args[0])
    elif command == "SCORE"
        valid = args[0] == "AREA" or args[0] == "TERRITORY"
    if not valid
        emit("ERROR bad arguments")
        return
    p := -1
    if includes(["PLAY", "GROUP", "LADDER", "DEAD"], command)
        p = point_number(if command == "PLAY" then args[1] else args[0], game.size)
        if p < 0
            emit("ERROR bad point")
            return
    ReplayRecord[] sequence := []
    if command == "REPLAY"
        match parse_record(args[0], game.size)
            ReplayRecord[] parsed
                sequence = parsed
            none
                emit("ERROR bad sequence")
                return
    if game.position.over and includes(["PLAY", "PASS", "REPLAY"], command)
        emit("ERROR game over")
        return
    if command == "BOARD"
        reset(&game, new_size, parsed_komi)
        emit("board {new_size} komi {half(parsed_komi)}")
    elif command == "KOMI"
        game.komi = parsed_komi
        emit("komi {half(parsed_komi)}")
    elif command == "SUPERKO"
        game.superko = args[0] == "ON"
        emit("superko " + (if game.superko then "on" else "off"))
    elif command == "HANDICAP"
        if #game.history != 0 or #[for disc := game.position.board[] if disc != "." then disc] > 0
            emit("ERROR handicap not allowed")
            return
        count := int(args[0])
        int[] indices := if count == 5 then [0, 1, 2, 3, 8] elif count == 7 then [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8] else [for i := (0:<int(count))[] then i]
        handicap_points := handicap_names(game.size)
        result := "handicap {count}"
        for i := indices[]
            target := point_number(handicap_points[i], game.size)
            game.handicap = game.handicap.append(target)
            game.position.board[target] = "B"
            result += " " + handicap_points[i]
        game.position.turn = "W"
        game.positions = [game.position.board]
        game.dead = array(nat(game.size * game.size), fill = false)
        emit(result)
    elif command == "PLAY"
        color := args[0]
        candidate := check(game, color, p)
        why := if color != game.position.turn then "turn" else candidate.reason
        if why != ""
            emit("ILLEGAL {color} {args[1]} {why}")
        else
            captured := move(&game, color, p, candidate)
            emit("{color} {args[1]}" + (if captured > 0 then " captures {captured}" else ""))
    elif command == "PASS"
        color := args[0]
        if color != game.position.turn
            emit("ILLEGAL {color} pass turn")
        else
            move(&game, color, -1)
            emit("{color} pass")
            if game.position.over
                emit("game over")
    elif command == "REPLAY"
        count := 0
        stopped := ""
        for entry := sequence[]
            color := entry.color
            square := entry.point
            candidate := if square >= 0 then check(game, color, square) else Attempt([], 0, "")
            why := if game.position.over then "game over" elif color != game.position.turn then "turn" else candidate.reason
            if why != ""
                stopped = " stopped {color} " + (if square < 0 then "pass" else point_name(square, game.size)) + " {why}"
                break
            move(&game, color, square, candidate)
            count += 1
        emit("replay {count} moves" + stopped)
        if game.position.over
            emit("game over")
    elif command == "UNDO"
        if #game.history == 0
            emit("ERROR nothing to undo")
            return
        last := game.history[-1]
        game.history = game.history[:<#game.history - 1]
        game.position = last.before
        game.positions = game.positions[:<#game.positions - 1]
        game.dead = array(nat(game.size * game.size), fill = false)
        emit("undo {last.color} " + (if last.point < 0 then "pass" else point_name(last.point, game.size)))
    elif command == "SHOW" or command == "MAP"
        board_display(game, command == "MAP")
    elif command == "STATUS"
        emit("size {game.size} komi {half(game.komi)} handicap {#game.handicap} superko " + (if game.superko then "on" else "off"))
        emit("moves {#game.history} " + (if game.position.over then "game over" else "next {game.position.turn} passes {game.position.passes}"))
    elif command == "CAPTURES"
        emit("captures B {game.position.captures[0]} W {game.position.captures[1]}")
    elif command == "HISTORY"
        emit("history {#game.history}")
        for: i < #game.history
            item := game.history[i]
            emit("{i + 1} {item.color} " + (if item.point < 0 then "pass" else point_name(item.point, game.size)) + (if item.captured > 0 then " captures {item.captured}" else ""))
    elif command == "MOVES"
        result := "(;GM[1]FF[4]SZ[{game.size}]KM[{half(game.komi)}]"
        if #game.handicap > 0
            result += "HA[{#game.handicap}]AB"
            for point := game.handicap[]
                result += "[" + sgf(point, game.size) + "]"
        for item := game.history[]
            result += ";{item.color}[" + (if item.point < 0 then "" else sgf(item.point, game.size)) + "]"
        emit(result + ")")
    elif command == "GROUP" or command == "DEAD" or command == "LADDER"
        if game.position.board[p] == "."
            emit("ERROR no stone")
            return
        g := group(game.position.board, game.size, p)
        if command == "GROUP"
            emit("group {g.color} {point_name(g.first, game.size)} size {#g.stones} liberties {#g.liberties}")
            emit("stones" + [for q := g.stones[] then " " + point_name(q, game.size)].join(""))
            emit("liberties" + [for q := g.liberties[] then " " + point_name(q, game.size)].join(""))
        elif command == "DEAD"
            bool was_dead := game.dead[p]
            for stone := g.stones[]
                game.dead[stone] = not was_dead
            emit((if was_dead then "alive" else "dead") + " {g.color} {point_name(g.first, game.size)} size {#g.stones}")
        else
            liberties := int(#g.liberties)
            label := ""
            chosen := -1
            if liberties >= 3
                label = "safe"
            elif liberties == 1
                result := defend(game.position.board, game.size, p, 0)
                label = if result.success then "escapes" else "captured"
                chosen = if result.success then result.point else -1
            else
                result := attack(game.position.board, game.size, p, 0)
                label = if result.success then "captured" else "escapes"
                chosen = if result.success then result.point else -1
            emit("ladder {args[0]} {label}" + (if chosen >= 0 then " {point_name(chosen, game.size)}" else ""))
    elif command == "GROUPS"
        all := groups(game.position.board, game.size)
        emit("groups {#all}")
        for g := all[]
            emit("{g.color} {point_name(g.first, game.size)} size {#g.stones} liberties {#g.liberties}" + (if game.dead[g.first] then " dead" else ""))
    elif command == "ATARI"
        all := groups(game.position.board, game.size)
        found := false
        for g := all[]
            if #g.liberties == 1
                found = true
                emit("atari {g.color} {point_name(g.first, game.size)} size {#g.stones} at {point_name(g.liberties[0], game.size)}")
        if not found
            emit("atari none")
    elif command == "LEGAL"
        color := args[0]
        string[] rejected := []
        legal_count := 0
        for: cell < int(#game.position.board)
            if game.position.board[cell] != "."
                continue
            result := check(game, color, cell)
            if result.reason != ""
                rejected = rejected.append(point_name(cell, game.size) + " " + result.reason)
            else
                legal_count += 1
        emit("legal {color} {legal_count}")
        for entry := rejected[]
            emit(entry)
    elif command == "EYES"
        color := args[0]
        string[] result := []
        for: cell < int(#game.position.board)
            if game.position.board[cell] != "."
                continue
            neighbors := adjacent(cell, game.size)
            shape := true
            for neighbor := neighbors[]
                if game.position.board[neighbor] != color
                    shape = false
                    break
            if not shape
                continue
            opponents := 0
            for neighbor := adjacent(cell, game.size, true)[]
                if game.position.board[neighbor] == other(color)
                    opponents += 1
            result = result.append(point_name(cell, game.size) + (if opponents <= (if #neighbors == 4 then 1 else 0) then " real" else " false"))
        emit("eyes {color} {#result}")
        for entry := result[]
            emit(entry)
    elif command == "SAFE"
        all := safe(game.position.board, game.size, args[0])
        emit("safe {args[0]} {#all}")
        for g := all[]
            emit("{point_name(g.first, game.size)} size {#g.stones}")
    elif command == "REGIONS"
        all := regions(clean(game), game.size)
        emit("regions {#all}")
        for region := all[]
            emit("{point_name(region.first, game.size)} size {#region.points} {region.owner}")
    elif command == "SCORE"
        score(game, args[0])

string number_of_commands
scan(&number_of_commands)
game := Game()
for: int i < int(number_of_commands)
    string line
    scan(&line)
    execute(&game, line)
